items.title: Tom Porrello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 6, 2023
items.q: I said to Bill Byrne who was the manager, who was also in the Naval Academy band with me, Bill Byrne.

ctx.x: Stan was like — if you played with Stan Kenton you’re part of the family. That’s the way he treats you, like you’re family. When you ask him, “Who’s the greatest lead trumpet player you ever had?” He’d say, “The one I have right now.” And I’m sure when I left he

said the same thing to the next guy. We played once in Hollywood and we played in a club and behind me were like four ex-Kenton trumpet players looking over my shoulder. And Stan after he got done Stan gave me a big hug and that’s the way he dealt with it. And Harry was always great, he liked me a lot luckily. He left a little space between him and a lot of the band, you know. Not that he was arrogant with anybody, but he wasn’t like, it wasn’t exactly like family like Stan’s was. And Woody, he was just a good —…
